lines.trans: Our destiny always leaves us clues.
Following them, we end up where we are meant to be.
Sometimes we follow a false trail.
Attention, the inspector left a review on the Michelin website!
The hotel restaurant in the heart of the capital is worth visiting.

words.gloss: in the presence of, in front of; at, under

lines.trans: For its unexpected takes on classic French cuisine!
Congratulations, it is the first such restaurant in Russia!
Max, you did a great job, this is your success!
Thank you, guys, I did not expect it myself!
When you have made mistakes so often in life...
You stop paying attention to the clues of fate.
And simply walk calmly along your own road.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be; there is'.
future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: + prepositional (where). Core Russian prep meaning 'in, into' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Внимание! = Attention!.

examples.text: А ну-ка, дай посмотрю! Внимание, ребята!
examples.trans: Hold on, let me have a look! Attention, everyone!
She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.note: Location; for direction use 'куда'. Core Russian adv meaning 'where' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: В дорогу = for the journey.

examples.text: Какая разница, кто будет строить дороги?
examples.trans: What does it matter who builds the roads?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: In one direction, now. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.
To run for a second term. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: sometimes, from time to time, occasionally

examples.text: Иногда наши победы бывают слишком странными.
examples.trans: Sometimes our victories turn out too strange.
Sometimes it is useful to trust others.

meanings.note: From Latin 'inspector' (observer, overseer, from 'inspicere', to look into).

examples.text: Инспекторы ищут нарушения только ради денег.
examples.trans: Inspectors look for violations only for money.
The inspector is checking the kitchen.

meanings.note: Question word and conjunction.

examples.trans: When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: ложный вызов = false alarm; ложный гипс = fake cast

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, зачем вам этот ложный гипс на руках?
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, why do you need those fake casts on your arms?

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child
Old-fashioned.

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'we' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: + prepositional: на сайте. Core Russian prep meaning 'on, onto; for' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'ожиданный').

examples.text: Жизнь учит нас неожиданным поворотам судьбы.
examples.trans: Life teaches us unexpected turns of fate.

examples.text: Самоуверенность часто приводит к неожиданным проблемам.

examples.text: Не обращай внимания на его громкие шутки.
examples.trans: Do not pay attention to his loud jokes.

examples.text: Шеф всегда обращает внимание на каждую мелочь на тарелке.
examples.trans: The chef always pays attention to every little detail on the plate.

meanings.note: + genitive or accusative: я не ожидал = I didn't expect (that)
Formal.

examples.trans: Arkasha, I didn't expect that. Thank you!

оказываться.gloss: to turn out to be, prove to be

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be, find oneself

examples.trans: Simple things turn out to be important.

examples.text: Иногда простые вещи оказываются самыми важными.
examples.trans: Sometimes simple things turn out to be the most important.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: Оставь мне кусок = save me a piece.

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

examples.text: Вика, ну он одинокий. Я же не оставлю его одного.
examples.trans: Vika, come on, he's all alone. I can't just leave him on his own.

examples.text: Я тебе оставляю пять миллионов и условный срок.
examples.trans: I'll leave you five million and a suspended sentence.

examples.text: В нашем отеле действует новая услуга.
examples.trans: Our hotel has a new service.

examples.text: Кто бы мог подумать, что буду управлять отелем?
examples.trans: Who'd have thought I'd be running a hotel?

But the critic will write a terrible review!

examples.text: Неужели критик уже выпустил свой разгромный отзыв?

ошибаться.gloss: to make a mistake, be mistaken

meanings.en: to make a mistake, be mistaken

examples.trans: In my opinion, you are sorely mistaken.

examples.text: Макс, умные повара вообще не ошибаются.
examples.trans: Max, smart cooks do not make mistakes at all.

при.gloss: in the presence of, by, at

meanings.en: in the presence of, at, attached to
meanings.note: + prepositional; ни при чём = has nothing to do with it / not to blame

examples.trans: And what does Lyolya have to do with it?

examples.text: Всё, я ухожу. Ребёнок ни при чём. Передай это Алексею.
examples.trans: That's it, I'm leaving. The child isn't to blame. Give this to Alexei.

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
Это просто = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: e.g. принял решение = made a decision

meanings.note: Сам, сама, само, сами.

meanings.note: напасть на след = to pick up the trail
